result.reason: The redline fixes the software warranty duration at the preferred 12 months and retains correction, replacement, and refund remedies. However, it does not add a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a separate 90-day services period, or a compliance-with-laws warranty. Its malicious-code warranty is also limited to willfully introduced code and only applies during the Warranty Period, falling short of an unqualified no-malicious-code warranty. Applying the 12-month period to MarketSite.net Service also exceeds the preferred services duration, so the change is not narrowly tailored. Unrelated commercial intent is otherwise preserved, and the new duration language is generally clear.
